from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=min(c for c in cnt if c!=bg)
    fill = marker+1 if marker+1<=9 else marker-1
    for r in g:
        idx=[i for i,c in enumerate(r) if c==marker]
        if len(idx)>=2:
            for i in range(idx[0],idx[-1]+1):
                if r[i]==bg:
                    r[i]= fill if (i-idx[0])%2 else marker
    return g
